The Evidence Compiler separates analytical truth from presentation. R creates `rlearnxr-evidence-2`; renderers consume it and never estimate the underlying model.

```{r}
library(rlearnxr)
model <- lm(mpg ~ wt + hp, data = mtcars)
evidence <- as_rlearnxr_evidence(model)
summary(evidence)
head(as.data.frame(evidence))
```

An observation has one stable `observation_id`. Every observation-dimension value has an `evidence_id`. The same identifiers appear in JSON, the semantic table, scene marks, explanation criteria, and the learner receipt. This is the contract that makes changes of representation inspectable and reproducible.
